entities.name: Handover to NR procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by RAN using another RAT to handover to NR, involving sending RRCReconfiguration message and applying security and bearer re-establishment.

entities.name: RRCReconfiguration message
entities.description: Message sent via the radio access technology from which the inter-RAT handover is performed to initiate handover to NR.

entities.name: Activate ciphering
entities.description: Network action to activate ciphering, possibly using NULL algorithm, if not yet activated in the other RAT.

entities.name: Re-establish SRBs and DRBs
entities.description: Network action to re-establish Signaling Radio Bearers and one or more Data Radio Bearers during handover.

entities.name: Ciphering not activated in other RAT
entities.description: Condition where ciphering is not yet activated in the other RAT, triggering activation during handover.

relations.description: Handover to NR procedure involves sending RRCReconfiguration message.
Handover to NR procedure includes activating ciphering.
Handover to NR procedure includes re-establishing SRBs and DRBs.
Condition that ciphering is not activated in other RAT triggers the activation of ciphering.
